east_catalysts_risks.notes: Thin window. The Deccan Herald BBC lead (land awards and payouts by December) and the Blue Line delay report (full opening March 2028) returned 403 on fetch, so I saw only search-engine paraphrases. I did not report either as a claim because I had no verbatim excerpt. In the paraphrase, the BBC corridor chairperson L K Atheeq targets December for awards and compensation on cloverleaf land. The Blue Line paraphrase said Iblur–Silk Board trials slip to Dec/Jan. Both are worth verifying manually. The Bangalore Mirror STRR, NammaWard gazette, Urban Acres, Sumadhura/Iron Hill, PRLog and IndulgExpress leads were not found or were low value. I found no in-window news on Varthur/Bellandur flooding, Sarjapur–Hebbal metro approval, or suburban rail. The Sarjapur–Hebbal search paraphrase said BMRCL expects central approval by October 2026, but I could not verify it. The Hoskote items are proposals, not funded or approved works, apart from the ADB approval the MLA claims, which is unverified independently. Office figures are from brokers and research houses, which are interested parties.

east_launches_prices.notes: No new east Bengaluru project launches or new phases dated 29 Oct to 1 Nov 2026 were found. Searches mostly returned aggregator and SEO pages and older launches. Site-filtered searches for ET, Moneycontrol, The Hindu, TOI, HT and NIE were blocked by the search tool. I didn't search the RERA portal at project level. Leads: (1) Hoskote water and metro (Siasat, 31 Oct) confirmed and reported. (2) Sumadhura/Iron Hill Brewery (Realty Today): a search snippet says it is a plan to lease 20,000 sq ft at Capitol Towers, Whitefield, with an opening before end-2026. The article fetch failed with a 500 error, so there is no verbatim excerpt and it is not reported as a claim. It is also a commercial/retail item. (3) Arvind ITPL/PRLog and IndulgExpress Whitefield: no relevant primary content found. Arvind ITPL Whitefield is a pre-launch project of about 210 homes on 3 acres near Singayyanapalya, per a PropNewz review; this is unverified and undated. Possible candidates for later checking, all undated or outside the window: Shriram Properties' Sarjapur Main Road parcel (launch said to be in late 2026), Godrej Whitefield/Soukya Road villas (pre-launch as of Aug 2026), and Brigade Citrine (Budigere Cross).

government_watch.notes: Only partial coverage. 12 searches and 3 successful fetches were run, short of the 6-page minimum, because the Deccan Herald listing and The Hindu were blocked and the web search did not surface the in-window Deccan Herald articles. Not verified from the original in-window articles: Silk Board junction revamp, K-RIDE Rs 511-cr contracts, Bengaluru Business Corridor land awards by December, and Karanth Layout registration close. Search returned only older background for these, with unclear dates, so no claims were made. Search-result snippets mention the Bengaluru Business Corridor (cabinet approved five compensation options; BDA began issuing awards) and a GBA technical committee clearing a Rs 450-crore ORR revamp between Silk Board and KR Puram, all undated and unverified. No in-window Karnataka cabinet decision, K-RERA order or stamp duty/guidance value change was found. The Bengaluru East e-Khata directive (31 Oct, Bengaluru Live) was seen only as a listing summary and was not fetched.

market_baseline.notes: Baseline task; no project launches. Sources that fetched as text were limited. ANAROCK and Knight Frank PDFs returned binary and could not be read, so their micro-market tables are unextracted. Deccan Herald returned 403 on two articles, including the ANAROCK Thanisandra Road (67%) and Sarjapur Road (63%) 3-year piece found in search. Search snippets also showed plot land-rate figures (e.g. Devanahalli Rs 7,000-9,600/sqft, March 2026) and rental yield ranges (Whitefield 3.8-4.5%) only from broker or developer blogs, which I did not fetch and therefore did not report as claims. The ANAROCK 8% and PropTiger 26% price growth figures are not comparable. The PropNewz page date (2026-08-26) is an 'Updated on' label, but its URL slug suggests 2026-05-09. Suggested follow-ups: ANAROCK micro-market PDFs via a text-capable route, Knight Frank H1 2026 Bengaluru table, RESIDEX, PropEquity micro-market data.

metro_watch.notes:
Pink Line: CMRS clearance and the 15 November inauguration talk are covered by three outlets. The Daily Jagran gives the clearance date as Wednesday 28 October. The bengalurumetro.in site, which is unofficial and not cited, also says 28 October. The 15 November date is unconfirmed; the CM said Modi 'might' come and the minister said it may be finalised by mid-November. Sources give the length as 7.38 km or 7.5 km.

Deccan Herald returned 403 on direct fetch, so these leads are not reported: the K-RIDE Rs 511-crore Corridor 4 awards, the Silk Board revamp and the CMRS 3-day inspection. A search summary said the Rs 511-crore awards were made on 29 October and that Package 1 (Rs 342 crore) went to an RNS Infrastructure–Gayatri Projects JV. That was not verified against the article text. The Kanaka Line Rs 105.66-crore ROB/RUB award and the Business Corridor land-award leads were not found. No official BMRCL or K-RIDE pages were opened. Nothing was found on fares, ridership records, Red Line or Phase 3 within the window.

north_south_west.notes: Little verifiable in-window news was found. The Hindu blocks WebFetch, and Deccan Herald returned 403. Searches found no independent coverage of these leads: IKEA's second store in south Bengaluru, Jalahalli underpass technique, Yelahanka SFS 208 closures, BDA Arekere, Silk Board revamp and drain upgrade, and Sunkadakatte. They are unverified; the headlines exist only as leads. The IndiGo tail-strike reports found were dated 27 Sep 2026, so they may not match the 31 Oct lead. No in-window villa, plot or apartment launches were found for the north, south or west corridors beyond the Orchid Nirvana release (6 Oct, before the window). Portal and aggregator pages were undated or promotional and were not reported. Claims here come only from pages I read in full. Search-snippet items (KNS Ananta Kengeri, Embassy six north-Bengaluru projects announced Nov 2025, Anarock Q2 2026) were not opened and are not reported as claims.

social_signals.notes: No social-media content from the window (29 Oct–1 Nov 2026) could be found. Reddit was blocked to the fetch tool and surfaced in no search result. YouTube returned no listings. LinkedIn returned HTTP 403 (login required) and surfaced no public posts. The 10 searches returned almost entirely developer and broker blogs (Sobha, Brigade, NBR, Godrej, Puravankara, PropNewz), all interested parties, and none was dated inside the window. The four claims above are background only, all dated before the window or undated, and none is supported by an official source. Figures conflict: Budigere Cross plots are quoted at ₹5,500–11,000/sqft by Aurum, while another portal snippet gave Hoskote plots at ₹1,800–3,500/sqft, and I did not fetch that page. Timing claims for the Blue Line and Pink Line are inconsistent across the developer and broker blogs, so none is reported. I saw a Deccan Herald e-khata/property-tax story only as a search snippet and could not open it, so I made no claim from it.
